limitations: Every contact, material, effective mass, impulse, friction and vehicle configuration is authored, not a native observation.
Fixed contact radiators; moving structural/contact paths and live collision acquisition remain unimplemented.
GTA material IDs and physicsDictionary hashes do not prove acoustic coefficients or collision-resource links.
RSC7 original fixtures do not verify Enhanced Gen9 resources, effective mounts, MLO/conditional activation or a complete installed world.
Runtime disk preparation currently uses the existing authored fixture-static store; the actual-resource versioned cache identity is not a whole-world writer.
Cross-tile acoustic unions, moving overlays and live observation adapters remain unqualified.
Measured worker cost/RSS and rendered onset are not audio callback, WASAPI submission or speaker latency.
Functional PCM and analytic path differences do not establish perceptual realism or calibrated sound power.
No original Bati bank/calibration/gain/default route changed by this scope.
